## Definition of done

- [ ] The task's "Done when" line is met and covered by tests
- [ ] All checks green: lint, types, tests, accessibility, audits, scans
- [ ] The eight security rules still hold (`docs/scope-decisions.md`, section 4)
- [ ] Security-reviewer approval, if this touches sign-in, sessions, permissions, people data, backups or the updater
- [ ] Each new dependency has a written reason below and is pinned with hashes
- [ ] Every page loads only from the site's own origin
- [ ] Export, audit trail and data-flows page cover any new data or outside service
- [ ] Admin and operator docs updated, and any decision change logged with a date
- [ ] Reviewed by an agent other than the builder
